pass.answer: Round 2 reviews only what the fix pass changed, plus its Not applied rows, not the whole branch. Marks decide nothing.
It doesn't re-review the full diff; marks never gate anything.
Marks gate nothing; they sit in the run file's Marks section.

fail.answer: Round 2 re-reviews the whole branch diff.
Round 2 reviews the entire change again with the fixes applied.
The marks rank the members and stop the loop when high enough.
